title: One AI-powered elder-safety platform for every residence and every home.
client: Enterprise deployment · 6 care communities (≈ 540 beds) + 250 at-home residents
author: Colin Cook

items.name: Resident, family and care-plan engine
items.what: One record per resident: care plan, fall-risk score, consent forms, emergency contacts, family access, room/home assignment and device inventory.
items.tech: Next.js + TypeScript, PostgreSQL (Supabase or AWS RDS), FHIR R4 data model, row-level security per facility.
items.ai: Claude summarises care notes into a 3-line daily brief per resident; fall-risk score from history + gait trend.

items.name: Camera and sensor ingestion (edge NVR)
items.what: Connects PoE/Wi-Fi cameras, mmWave radars and wearables at every site into one secure edge box per building or home.
items.tech: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano / Orin NX edge box, RTSP/ONVIF, go2rtc restreaming, MQTT bus, WireGuard tunnel to cloud.
items.ai: Edge inference with TensorRT; only events and skeletons leave the building, never raw video by default.

items.name: 24/7 monitoring command center
items.what: Live wall for nurses and the central response desk: rooms, residents, alerts, escalation timers and acknowledgements.
items.tech: React + WebRTC (sub-second video on demand), WebSockets, role-based access, audit log on every view.
items.ai: Priority ranking of open alerts; VLM second-look caption on each event ("resident seated on floor beside bed").

items.name: Caregiver mobile app (iOS and Android)
items.what: Staff get the alert, see the skeleton clip, tap Accept, and log the outcome. Hands-free voice acknowledge.
items.tech: React Native (Expo), APNs/FCM critical alerts, offline queue, SSO (SAML/OIDC).
items.ai: Voice acknowledge and dictated incident notes (Whisper), auto-filled into the report.

items.name: Family portal and app
items.what: Families see wellbeing (sleep, activity, check-ins), receive alerts they opt into and can video-call their loved one.
items.tech: Same Expo codebase, separate role; consent-gated data views; Stripe billing for at-home plans.
items.ai: Weekly AI wellbeing letter in plain language, written from activity data, never from video.

items.name: EHR and nurse-call integration
items.what: Pushes incidents and vitals into PointClickCare / MatrixCare and triggers existing nurse-call systems.
items.tech: HL7 v2 + FHIR interface engine, vendor APIs, dry-contact relay for legacy nurse call.
items.ai: Maps free-text notes to coded fields (fall type, injury, location) for the EHR.

items.name: Moving your data over
items.what: Imports residents, rooms, contacts and incident history from spreadsheets or the current EHR.
items.tech: ETL scripts, validation reports, rollback plan.
items.ai: Claude-assisted field mapping and de-duplication with human sign-off.

items.name: Vision fall detection (privacy skeleton mode)
items.what: Detects falls, slides from bed/chair and residents on the floor in under 3 seconds, from pose keypoints instead of faces.
items.tech: YOLO11-pose or RTMPose on the edge box, ByteTrack IDs, temporal classifier (ST-GCN) on 2-second keypoint windows.
items.ai: Train/validate on UR Fall, Le2i and CAUCAFall + your own consented, labelled clips; target ≥ 95% recall, < 1 false alarm per room per week.

items.name: Bathroom and bedroom radar (no camera)
items.what: Fall, presence, breathing-rate and in-bathroom-too-long detection where cameras are never allowed.
items.tech: 60 GHz mmWave fall-detection radars (e.g. Seeed MR60FDA2, Aqara FP2, TI IWR6843) over Wi-Fi/Zigbee → MQTT.
items.ai: Fusion rule engine: radar fall + no motion for 30 s + no wearable step = confirmed alert.

items.name: Wander, exit and bed-exit alerts
items.what: Virtual zones: memory-care doors, stairwells, bed edge at night, kitchen stove left on.
items.tech: Polygon zones per camera, time-of-day schedules, door contacts and smart locks.
items.ai: Tracker-based zone crossing with direction; night-time bed-exit predicted from restlessness 2-5 min early.

items.name: AI false-alarm verifier (second look)
items.what: Before anyone is paged, a vision-language model checks the clip: real fall, or a resident doing yoga on the rug?
items.tech: Small VLM on the edge box (Moondream / Florence-2 / Qwen2.5-VL 3B), escalates to a cloud model when unsure.
items.ai: Cuts false alarms 60-80% in pilots of this design; every suppressed alert is still logged for audit.

items.name: Acoustic distress detection
items.what: Hears 'help', crying out, a thud or breaking glass and links it to the room's camera/radar.
items.tech: On-device audio classification; keyword spotting; no audio recorded or stored.
items.ai: YAMNet sound classes + Whisper-tiny keyword spotting in English and Spanish.

items.name: Daily-living baseline and decline alerts
items.what: Learns each resident's normal: sleep, bathroom visits, meals, steps, gait speed. Flags changes days before a crisis (UTI, dehydration, depression, rising fall risk).
items.tech: Time-series store (TimescaleDB), nightly jobs, wearable data (Apple HealthKit, Health Connect).
items.ai: Per-resident anomaly models (Isolation Forest / seasonal baselines) + Claude-written explanation for the nurse.

items.name: 24/7 AI voice check-in concierge
items.what: Calls or speaks to the resident after an alert or on schedule: 'Are you alright, Margaret?' Escalates if no answer or distress.
items.tech: Telephony (Twilio) + smart speaker in room, real-time voice agent pipeline.
items.ai: Claude as the conversational brain, streaming STT/TTS; strict script guardrails, never gives medical advice.

items.name: AI incident reports and shift handover
items.what: Drafts the state-compliant incident report, family notification and end-of-shift summary from the event timeline.
items.tech: Templating per state, e-signature, PDF export, stored in EHR.
items.ai: Claude drafts from structured events + caregiver voice note; nurse reviews and signs.

items.name: Alert escalation engine
items.what: Nearest caregiver → charge nurse → on-call manager → family → 911, with timers and acknowledgements at every step.
items.tech: Durable workflows, SMS/voice/push, on-call rotas, geolocated staff badges (optional BLE).
items.ai: Picks the closest free caregiver from badge location and current workload.

items.name: Privacy, consent and HIPAA security
items.what: Consent per resident and roommate, camera privacy schedules, skeleton-only mode, encryption, full audit trail, BAA-ready hosting.
items.tech: AWS (HIPAA-eligible services + BAA), KMS encryption, SSO/MFA, immutable audit log, SOC 2 readiness (Vanta/Drata).
items.ai: On-device face blurring for any clip that is ever shared; no facial recognition anywhere.

items.name: Operations and compliance analytics
items.what: Falls per 1,000 resident-days, response times, repeat fallers, staffing vs incidents, state-survey-ready exports.
items.tech: Metabase / Superset dashboards on a read replica.
items.ai: Ask-in-English analytics: 'Which wing had the slowest night responses last month?'

items.name: Website, online enrollment and at-home ordering
items.what: Brand site, facility demo booking, family self-enrollment for at-home plans, hardware checkout.
items.tech: Next.js, Stripe, Calendly/Cal.com, CMS.
items.ai: AI chat on the site that answers plan, privacy and pricing questions and books demos.

sections.name: Ongoing support, hosting and usage (12 months)

items.name: Cloud hosting, security and backups ($2,140/mo)
items.what: HIPAA-eligible AWS, video-on-demand relay, encrypted backups, uptime monitoring.
items.tech: AWS, Cloudflare, Grafana/Prometheus.

items.name: AI usage, voice and messaging ($1,960/mo)
items.what: LLM calls, voice minutes, SMS and push volume across all sites.
items.tech: Anthropic API, Twilio, FCM/APNs.
items.ai: Claude (Haiku for routine, Sonnet/Opus for reports) with prompt caching.

items.name: Edge hardware lease (34 edge boxes, 210 radars, 260 cameras)
items.what: Leased, insured and replaced on failure. At-home kits ship pre-paired.
items.tech: Jetson Orin, PoE cameras, mmWave radars, SOS wearables.

items.name: Staff training and rollout
items.what: On-site go-live at each community, train-the-trainer, family onboarding webinars.
items.tech: LMS videos, printed quick cards.
items.ai: AI training assistant inside the caregiver app.

items.name: Dedicated engineering, model tuning and support
items.what: Named engineer, 24/7 P1 support, quarterly fall-model retraining on your labelled events.
items.tech: SLA 99.9%, 15-minute P1 response.
items.ai: Continuous evaluation: recall, false alarms per room-week, time-to-alert.
